reviewMethod: Context review of the deterministic proposal; term-wide exclusions apply only to the exact proposed source phrase

rejectLemmas.this time: Ordinary demonstrative noun phrase, including 'by this time'.
rejectLemmas.now for: All three hits cross the boundary between adverb 'now' and a following 'for' phrase.
rejectLemmas.be a man: Literal predication in this book, not a conversational formula.
rejectLemmas.of old: False hit inside 'disc of old copper'.
rejectLemmas.as ever: Both hits belong to longer comparative clauses, not the standalone formula.
rejectLemmas.come on: 'Come on them suddenly' means encounter them, not the conversational formula.
rejectLemmas.precious little: False hit across 'precious Little Ones', a named group.
rejectLemmas.on the whole: False hit inside 'effect on the whole army'.
rejectLemmas.and then some: False hit across 'and then some incipient air'.
rejectLemmas.at that: Both hits are ordinary preposition plus determiner: 'at that time/door'.
rejectLemmas.at the time: Compositional temporal phrase in both occurrences.
rejectLemmas.even then: Compositional adverb plus time reference in both occurrences.
rejectLemmas.too late: Compositional degree adverb plus adjective in all occurrences.

rejectOccurrences.reason: 'Turning my ring about to catch ...': about means around; to introduces purpose.
'In sight of my eyes' is literal wording, not the listed fixed expression.
'I fear for the children' is a lexical verb with complement.
'I fear that child' is a lexical verb with object.
'I fear the Shadow' is a lexical verb with object.

reclassifyOccurrences.reason: 'Was ... used to weeping' means accustomed to, not the habitual semi-modal 'used to'.
The complete construction means kneel; 'go down on' alone is incomplete.

sourceBoundaryRules.reason: Include the complete additive/comparative conjunction 'as well as' when followed by the second as.
Include the complete manner construction when the comparison is 'as well as I could'.
Include the complete 'so far as' construction.
Include the complete 'so far from' construction.
